common.nav.solutions: Header and footer link to the page «Solutions» (the nine robotics areas). A navigation label, not a section title.
common.nav.industries: Navigation link to the industries block of the home page. The breadcrumb link (common.crumbs.industries) and the card title on the solutions page are separate keys on purpose.
common.nav.platform: Navigation link to the block that explains the platform (header and footer).
common.nav.cases: Navigation link to the case studies. Not the same as the capital-letter section labels «КЕЙСЫ» (home.sections.cases, industries.common.sections.cases) or the link-card tag industries.common.kickers.cases.
common.nav.contacts: Navigation link to the contact block (header and footer). Compare common.cta.contact (the header button) and common.footer.nav.contact (a footer column).
common.cta.contact: Header button that scrolls to the contact form. A call to action, verb first. Not the nav link common.nav.contacts and not a form submit button.
common.footer.nav.*: Footer link. The target pages do not exist yet (placeholder links).
common.footer.wordmark1: First line of the company name drawn as a large two-line wordmark at the bottom of the footer (SVG text, not stretched: the Russian first line fills the page width). Keep the line about as long as the Russian one.
common.footer.wordmark2: Second line of the same footer wordmark. Starts in lower case in Russian because it continues the first line; capitalise it in English.
common.crumbs.*: Breadcrumb at the top of the industry pages: Home / Industries / <this page>.
common.form.name: Label of the name field in the contact form.
common.form.phone: Label of the phone field in the contact form.
common.form.directionUnknown: First, empty option of the drop-down list (the visitor has not decided yet).
common.form.consent: Consent checkbox text with a link to the privacy policy (the <a> stays). Legal text: the EN version comes from the company's lawyer (see style-guide R4).
home.sections.*: Small capital-letter label of a section: shown in the section counter at the left edge and, with the number, above the heading («02 — LABEL»). One text for both places; EN in capitals, not longer than the RU. «ГЕРОЙ» names the opening screen (design jargon), it is only visible in the counter.
home.hero.title: Headline of the home page, one sentence ending with a period.
roi.head.title: Headline of the calculator page, ends with a period.
home.hero.ctaRoi: Primary button of the first screen, opens the payback calculator. At most 28 characters, verb first.
home.hero.ctaCases: Secondary button of the first screen, scrolls to the case studies.
home.hero.robots.*.cat: Robot category: the label under the robot AND the title of the hover caption (data-cat), so one short word.
home.platform.core.devicesOnline: The message starts with a no-break space (U+00A0) that separates it from the number 142 in front of it. Keep it at the start.
home.tasks.items.custom.cta: Button on the last task card, scrolls to the contact form («pick a solution for me»).
home.industries.cta: Button in the industries block, scrolls to the contact form.
home.platform.dev.cta: Button, scrolls to the contact form; the arrow icon is outside the message.
home.platformUi.more: Button with an arrow character (↗) inside the message: keep it.
home.contact.ctaRoi: Main button of the closing block, opens the payback calculator; «за 2 минуты» is a promise, keep it.
solutions.sections.*: Small capital-letter label of a section (section counter and the «NN — LABEL» tag); EN in capitals, not longer than the RU.
solutions.hero.title.*: One line of the page headline; the two lines read as one sentence.
solutions.talk.form.submit: Submit button of the contact form. Says what happens next (a call is ordered), not «Submit».
solutions.talk.form.directionLabel: Label of the drop-down list with the nine areas; <small> holds «optional».
roi.head.label: Small tag above the headline: ОКУПАЕМОСТЬ is the bold part, the rest follows after a dash. Capitals.
roi.head.switch.*: Two-way switch at the top of the calculator (facade washing / floor cleaning); it is a radio button, so keep both short and parallel.
roi.facade.*.label: Label of a calculator slider; the chosen value is shown at the right end of the label line.
roi.facade.*.legend: Legend of a group of buttons in the facade calculator.
roi.facade.glass.*: Choice button: facade glazing (continuous glass / with protruding frames).
roi.floor.*.label: Label of a calculator slider; the chosen value is shown at the right end of the label line.
roi.floor.*.legend: Legend of a group of buttons in the floor-cleaning calculator.
roi.floor.who.*: Choice button: who cleans now (own staff / a cleaning company).
roi.out.fin.*: Choice button: buy the robot or lease it.
roi.out.cta: Button, scrolls to the application form. Verb first, at most 28 characters (КП = commercial proposal).
roi.out.share: Button that copies a link to the calculation; an icon sits next to the text.
roi.out.card: Button that saves the calculation as a picture; an icon sits next to the text.
roi.lead.label: Small tag above the form heading: КП (commercial proposal) in bold, then the rest. Capitals.
roi.lead.form.*: Field label or button of the application form under the calculator.
roi.lead.form.submit: Submit button of the application form; says what the visitor gets.
calc.types.*: Segment button: type of object in the floor-cleaning calculator. Also written into the result line by roi.js (js.roi.ctx.floor) and used on the industry pages' mini calculators; one translation for all.
calc.modes.*: Segment button: cleaning mode (number of shifts) in the calculators.
industries.common.sections.*: Small capital-letter label of a section of the industry pages (section counter and the «NN — LABEL» tag); EN in capitals, not longer than the RU. «КЕЙС» (one case) and «КЕЙСЫ» (several) are separate keys.
industries.*.secNames.*: The page's own section label (small capitals, section counter and tag); EN in capitals, not longer than the RU.
industries.*.nameCaps: The industry name in capitals: section counter and the tag above the headline. Same words as industries.<page>.name, upper-cased.
industries.*.h1.items.*: One line of the page headline (the lines are separate spans and read as one sentence ending with a period). Each line at most +15% of the RU line; the break between lines must stay possible.
industries.*.primaryCta.label: Primary call to action in the first screen of the industry page; verb first, at most 28 characters.
industries.*.form.button: Submit button of the contact form of this industry page; says what happens next, not «Submit».
industries.common.form.directionLabel: Label of the drop-down list with the page's directions; <small> holds «optional».
industries.common.calc.fullRoi: Link-button to the full calculator page; the arrow icon is outside the message.
industries.common.calc.object: Legend: type of object in the mini calculator.
industries.common.calc.area: Label of the area slider in the mini calculator.
industries.common.calc.mode: Legend: cleaning mode in the mini calculator.
industries.businessCenters.economy.area: Label of the area slider in the business-center mini calculator.
industries.businessCenters.ready.orderAu: Button in the readiness stamp, scrolls to the form.
js.**: Assembled by a script at run time: keep the variables in braces and the tags exactly; the table in i18n/js-sites.md says where each one is used.
common.nav.products: Navigation link to the page «Products» (own products and ways to work: platform, rental, retrofit). A navigation label, not the footer link common.footer.nav.products.
products.sections.*: Small capital-letter label of a section on the Products page (section counter and the «NN — LABEL» tag); EN in capitals, not longer than the RU.
products.hero.title: Headline of the Products page, ends with a period. «Модели работы» means business models (rent, upgrade), not work modes.
products.hero.ctaRaas: Primary button of the first screen, scrolls to the rental block. «RaaS» stays in brackets after the Russian name. At most 28 characters, verb first.
products.hero.ctaDemo: Secondary button of the first screen, scrolls to the form with the platform preselected.
products.platform.ctaDemo: Button on the dark platform panel, scrolls to the form with the platform preselected.
products.platform.ctaMore: Button with an arrow icon outside the message: opens the platform diagram on the home page.
products.raas.cta: Button in the rental block, scrolls to the form with the rental preselected. Same wording as the primary button of the first screen.
products.talk.form.productLabel: Label of the drop-down list in the form: which product the visitor is interested in; the <small> part is the grey hint «optional». Compare solutions.talk.form.directionLabel.
products.names.*: Product name. Used in the contents list, on the cards and in the form list: keep one wording. Latin names (Fleet Management, Retrofit, Open API) stay in the markup untranslated.
products.raas.calc.note: Disclaimer under the illustrative buy-or-rent calculation: market benchmarks, not a Professional Robotics tariff. Keep the 16% and the wording «illustration».
